acks.detail: skills/ultralearn/SKILL.md pilot-corpus claims: `.claude/ultrapowers/fleet-runs-2026-08-26/` holds "four distinct drive failure modes + one green engine run" and `fleet-runs-2026-08-27/` is run-13 green — `.claude/ultrapowers/` is gitignored and both evidence dirs are absent on this host, so the factual accuracy of the pilot-corpus pointer cannot be checked from the repo or the diff. The paragraph is structurally complete and instruction-only; only its factual referents are unverifiable here. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

fleet/shim.mjs mid-run reconnect restoring DRIVER-visible progress (operator smoke: kill the reverse-tunnel ssh mid-engine-phase and watch drive progress lines / shim.log reconnect messages) — Requires a live orchestrator plus a provisioned exe.dev sandbox and a real reverse tunnel to sever. The in-process test proves store-level resync only; the claim that the driver keeps seeing renews/spend instead of running down the 30-min heartbeat clock is only observable on a real run. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

fleet/shim-main.mjs delivered field and non-zero exit on a non-delivered outcome (operator smoke: read the last line of shim.log / the shim's printed outcome JSON after a fleet run) — The exit-code mapping runs only when shim-main.mjs is invoked as a process inside a sandbox; no test spawns it, so the printed outcome JSON and the non-zero exit are observable only on a live run. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

fleet/drive.mjs real-plan defaults end to end (operator smoke: run the RUNBOOK driver snippet without ttlMs/capTokens and read fleet-run.json + gate-read-<runId>.detail.json) — The constants themselves are unit-pinned by test 20, but the delivered assignment carrying ttlMs 14400000 and the detail carrying capTokens 500000 on a real drained plan needs an actual provisioned sandbox and control-plane round trip. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

ultralearn sense pass consuming a fleet evidence bundle so findings cite detail.* fields (operator smoke) — Requires dispatching a reader subagent against a real fleet-runs bundle and a human judging whether the returned findings actually cite detail.errors/timedOut/creditSpendUsd rather than transcript prose. The change is instruction-only, so no automated check can evidence it.
